description: The bar chart illustrates the Shapley value for three different models across various positional categories. The horizontal axis contains the categories, ordered sequentially from left to right as L₄⁺, L₃, L₂, L₁, T, R₁, R₂, R₃, and R₄⁺. The vertical axis represents the "Shapley value" on a linear scale, with a value range from slightly below 0 to 80, featuring tick marks and corresponding horizontal grid lines at intervals of 20 units. The chart displays grouped bars, where each category on the horizontal axis contains a cluster of three side-by-side bars representing different models, as indicated by a legend in the top right corner. The models are mBERT (light blue), XLM-R (dark blue), and chLSTM (light green), and all bars are outlined in black. The tallest bars are located in category T, where mBERT has an approximate value of 59, XLM-R is about 54, and chLSTM reaches the maximum chart value of approximately 79. The remaining categories feature significantly shorter bars, generally falling between slightly below 0 and 15. For instance, in category L₁, all three models show values of approximately 14, while in category R₁, values range from roughly 9 to 11. The shortest bars, some of which dip slightly below the zero line into negative values, belong to the chLSTM model in categories such as L₄⁺, R₂, R₃, and R₄⁺. The categories are arranged in a fixed sequence centered around T, and none of the bars are uniquely emphasized beyond their standard coloring and outlines.
caption_used: The bar chart illustrates the Shapley value for different models across various categories. The horizontal axis represents the categories labeled as L_4^+, L_3, L_2, L_1, T, R_1, R_2, R_3, R_4^+, while the vertical axis represents the 'Shapley value,' measured on a linear scale from 0 to 80 with tick intervals of 20 units. Bars are grouped by category, with each group containing three bars representing different models: mBERT (light blue), XLM-R (dark blue), and chLSTM (green). The tallest bars appear in category T, where mBERT has an approximate value of 50, XLM-R about 70, and chLSTM reaching the maximum value of 80. In other categories such as L_4^+, L_3, L_2, L_1, R_1, R_2, R_3, and R_4^+, the bars are all relatively short, generally below 15. Notably, the values for R_1 consistently exceed those for L_1 across all models, indicating a stronger contribution from the right context. A legend is provided in the top right corner.
